steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow used by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ as required before configuring the pricing event.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the sourcing sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Invite a QA vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Publish the RFQ to make it live.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Place the required vendor bid before attempting the exchange-rate edit.
Verify that the bid was accepted.
Ensure the exchange-rate action is performed from the buyer portal.

args.goal: On the buyer's live multi-currency event with the bid already placed, open the exchange-rate editor, attempt to change the exchange rate, and stop when the screen shows the refusal 'Exchange rates cannot be updated after bids have been placed.'

steps.note: Perform and observe the exchange-rate edit, which has no dedicated domain step.

args.text: Exchange rates cannot be updated after bids have been placed.

steps.note: Assert the exact refusal message requested by the case.
